Title: The Old Village

Cast

1. Tarun - 75 years, grandfather
Look: white dhoti, white kurta
2. Priya - 45 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vanusha - 10 years, granddaughter
Look: red frock

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
2. The courtyard - a clay floor, a churn
3. The river ghat - stone steps, the river

SCENE 1: The village well - Morning

[Priya stands at the well. Vanusha stands near her.]

Vanusha: "Can I help, Mother?"

[Priya draws water from the well with the rope.]

Priya: "Hold the bucket, careful!"

[Vanusha splashes water on her face at the well.]

SCENE 2: The courtyard - Day

[Tarun sits on the floor. Priya stands beside him.]

Tarun: "Bring me the churn."

[Tarun churns butter in the earthen pot.]

[Priya spins cotton on the spinning wheel.]

Vanusha: "Grandpa, tell me a story."

[Tarun clutches his chest, collapses with a heart attack and dies.]

Priya: "Babuji!"

SCENE 3: The river ghat - Evening

[Priya stands on the steps. Vanusha stands beside her, holding a lamp.]

[Priya folds her hands and prays for the departed soul.]

Vanusha: "We will never forget you, Grandpa."

[Vanusha lights the oil lamp and sets it on the river.]
